summary: community.routeros api_find_and_modify's ignore_dynamic and ignore_builtin defaults (false) will change to true in 4.0.0; set them explicitly, preferably true.
questions: Why do I get deprecation warnings for ignore_dynamic in api_find_and_modify?
What should I set ignore_builtin to?

answer_card.title: api_find_and_modify defaults changing
answer_card.answer_md: In `community.routeros.api_find_and_modify`, `ignore_dynamic` and `ignore_builtin` default to `false` but will change to **`true`** in 4.0.0. Set them explicitly to avoid warnings; `true` is recommended unless you have a reason for `false`.
